map.换算系数怎么定？: How is the conversion factor determined?
map.本工具侧重带'系数'的批量/自定义换算（适合模板化物料规格），另一工具按宽高+D: This tool focuses on batch/custom conversion with a "factor" (suiting templated material specifications), while the other converts between width/height and DPI in both directions and gives a physical size result. Pick whichever matches the form of the data you have; the results agree.
The factor is set by the target DPI: 1 px corresponds to 1/DPI inches and 25.4/DPI millimetres. At 96 DPI, 1px ≈ 0.2646mm; at 300 DPI ≈ 0.0847mm. Choosing the wrong DPI offsets the whole batch of material dimensions.
map.：输入数值 1000（px），换算系数 0.2646（即 96 DPI 下 1p: : entering 1000 (px) with a conversion factor of 0.2646 (i.e. 1px ≈ 0.2646mm at 96 DPI) from "ad size" to "milli ad size" -> 1000x0.2646 ≈ 264.6 mm. Switching to a 300 DPI factor of 0.0847, the same 1000px is only 84.7mm, showing that the same pixel count maps to a smaller physical size at high DPI.
